name: antimeridian
description: Longitudes wrap at +-180: 52N 179.995E to 52N 179.995W is 685 m, not 24,600 km.
worked_example: D9A03 at 52N 179.995E, UAL123 at 52N 179.995W: dlon = -359.99 wraps to +0.01 deg.

dx = 0.01 * pi/180 * cos(52 deg) * 6371000 = 684.58 m, dy = 0 -> horiz 684.58 m, bearing 90.0 -> TRAFFIC NEAR DRONE D9A03 (vert +100): 'GIVE WAY: DESCEND AND LAND D9A03; AIRCRAFT 100 M ABOVE, 680 M E'.
FAR2 at 179W is 1.0 deg (68.7 km) away -> nothing. Without the wrap: 359.99 deg of longitude = 24,640 km.

expect.summary: conflict watch on, 1 ADS-B conflict, data 3 s old

alerts.action: GIVE WAY: DESCEND AND LAND D9A03
